rain_input.source_status: supplied annual-maxima series; station/grid provenance not verified; 2026 excluded as incomplete year

metadata.vertical_reference: local source elevation frame; geodetic vertical datum unspecified; no sea-level boundary
metadata.boundary_assumption: Critical free outflow along valid-domain edges and NoData boundaries; no external catchment inflow. Interpretation near boundary is uncertain.
limitations: Parameters are estimates by 2018 land cover, not soil tests or measured impervious fractions.
Native 3m DEM averaged to calculation grid; streets and inlet details below that grid are unresolved.
No bathymetric adjustment or invented river cross-section.
Anegamiento classification is only a contextual comparison; it is not calibration with an observed event.
Daily river series are retained for hydrological context; no subhourly flood hydrograph is manufactured from them.

network.crs_interpretation: EPSG:32717 inferred from the portal projection formula; compare against original CAD/geodetic metadata.
network.visualization_fallback: Portal uses r[4] || 800 for rendering. Missing diameters remain NULL here; 800 mm is not adopted as a measured value.
network.candidate_assignment: Nearest CAD annotation within 5m; not assigned as invert or cover; review ambiguity and reference.

cartographic_culverts.meaning: AQ065 cartographic crossing/evacuation structures; not the 6359-segment sewer network.

terrain.vertical_datum: Not specified in inspected TIFF or XML. SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 17S identifies horizontal reference only.
terrain.lineage: Metadata creation/synchronization date is not a verified survey/acquisition date.

anegamiento.interpretation: Classified anegamiento layer. Event date, depth and method are not established by the inspected fields; not a measured flood footprint.

chibunga.units: Not explicit in inspected header; verify m3/s and origin-code definitions before using as boundary or calibration.
chibunga.origin_handling: H and PDM preserved separately. Do not assume all rows are gauge observations.

precipitation.kind: Annual maxima of accumulated 24h and 1h precipitation; not a storm hyetograph.
precipitation.limitations: Station/grid source, observation versus reanalysis and annual completeness need verification. Do not infer subhourly intensities from these maxima alone.

other_flow_csv.provenance: CSV lacks station identity/units in inspected header. Do not assume the same support or provenance as H0789.

source_audit.ready_for: GIS integration, terrain visualization and engineering-data reconciliation

sensitivity.comparison: Same 1h synthetic rain, same parameter rules, 24m vs 48m; valid masks differ at boundaries.
sensitivity.interpretation: Material grid sensitivity. Spatial extent has not converged; not suitable for parcel or street decisions.
sensitivity.comparison_es: La comparación de mallas corresponde exclusivamente al caso de referencia de 7,10 mm/h; no demuestra convergencia de los nuevos escenarios IDF.

notes_es: Lluvias variables de diseño de 6h: bloques alternos de 10min, pico central; simulación 12h con 6h de recesión. No reconstruyen los METAR ni un evento observado.
ESTRÉS HIPOTÉTICO: aumentos de lluvia elegidos (+25/+50/+100 %) respecto a la IDF T100. No son un pronóstico de El Niño ni máximos físicos; no tienen retorno asignado.
Aproximación exploratoria: no calibrada con eventos observados.
Relieve original de 3 m, cálculo a 24 m. Celdas sin terreno válido excluidas.

Escenarios IDF históricos de INAMHI: duración, estación y retorno de la lluvia identificados. Hietogramas de diseño identificados como uniformes o variables; el retorno de la inundación no está determinado.
Rugosidad e infiltración estimadas por cobertura 2018; faltan mediciones locales.
Red SWMM con cotas, salidas, captación y diámetros faltantes estimados. Acoplamiento de reboses hacia superficie en un sentido.
Caudales diarios del Chibunga, cuencas y anotaciones CAD revisados; faltan batimetría e hidrogramas de crecida para incorporarlos como frontera hidráulica.
ANEGAMIENTO2 se utiliza como clasificación de contexto; no como una inundación observada.
Sensibilidad a la malla significativa: la extensión inundada aún no converge.
Datum vertical del MDT no documentado; las alturas 3D son relativas al marco local suministrado.
display_note: Animation every 30min; display depths in centimetres. Original metric values are not rounded before area computation.

variable_sensitivity.interpretation: Two-grid sensitivity of this event only; valid masks also differ. No demonstrated spatial convergence or field validation.
